on.description: Config `claude.shareMemory` (spec §3.44): Claude sessions sideby starts in other accounts read and write the main account's memory for their project, and `sideby doctor --fix` moves memory an account wrote on its own into the main account.

main.description: The main account's folder that holds every project's memory.

account.description: The account the memory came from.

project.description: The project folder name under projects/.

files.description: How many files reached the main account.

folded.description: What `sideby doctor --fix` moved into the main account, oldest first.

path.description: The folder asked about (its real path).

name.description: Its project folder name under projects/.

memory.description: Where its memory goes for every Claude account sideby starts.

why.description: Why sideby cannot tell; such a session keeps its own memory.

dir.description: Where the memory of the folder asked about goes; only while on.

name.description: The project folder name under projects/.

main.description: Files in the main account's memory folder for it.

pending.description: Accounts that keep memory of their own for it: what `sideby doctor --fix` would move.

folded.description: Files `sideby doctor --fix` already moved in, per account.

projects.description: Each project with memory in the main account or in an account of its own; only while on. Nothing is read while off.

command.description: Run it after the user agrees: it shows the plan and exits 10; then --yes.

installed.description: The skill's version; null when it has none.

command.description: `sideby update`, which updates the skill with sideby: run it after the user agrees; it shows the plan and exits 10, then --yes.

_notice.description: Not the answer to the task: mention it briefly afterwards and offer to update.
